SUMMARY

SKILLS
Programming & Development: Python | R | Java | C# | PHP | JavaScript | SQL | HTML | CSS | Angular | Django | FastAPI | .NET | Flutter

EXPERIENCE

02/2025 -05/2025
Shelly Tunisie
PROJECTS
AI Engineer Data Scientist with hands-on experience in deep learning, multimodal Al systems (text, image, audio, video), and advanced data engineering. Skilled in ETL/ELT pipeline design, data preprocessing, model integration, and containerized deployment using modern ML frameworks and DevOps tools.
Customer Churn Prediction: Developed a predictive model using Python and scikit-learn to identify customers likely to leave a telecom service, including feature engineering, model evaluation, and reporting insights to improve retention.
Real-Time Music Trend Analysis: Built a streaming data pipeline using Kafka and Spark Streaming to ingest music-streaming events, detect trending tracks and listener patterns, and display results in real-time dashboards.
PCAP (Python Institute), Power BI Data Analyst (Microsoft), Building Transformer.Based Applications - NVIDIA DLI, AI-900 (Microsoft), Azure AI Engineer Associate (Microsoft AI-102)
Designed and shipped an end-to-end email automation SaaS (ingestion → NLP/LLM → ERP actions ), reducing manual handling time by ~65% .
Built a domain corpus (web scraping + Prodigy annotation); normalization, train/val/test splits, and data versioning for reproducibility.
Implemented spaCy NER (customers, products, references) with rule/regex post-validation for business checks.
Delivered a RAG pipeline with LangChain (retrievers, FAISS/Chroma vector store, prompt templates, retrieval-augmented generation ) and LLM rewriting (tone/style, summarization, FR/EN) with guardrails and context checks.
Built an Enterprise Document Management (EDM) platform (Angular + .NET + PostgreSQL) with indexed search and archival workflows, cutting retrieval time by ~75% .
Implemented IAM (roles & permissions, OAuth2), audit trails, and hardened access controls.
NLP Text Analytics Platform: Built an end-to-end NLP pipeline to process large-scale text, performing sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and entity extraction using spaCy, BERT embeddings, and Spark for scalable processing.
Vehicle Damage Detection (Computer Vision): Created a deep learning model to detect and classify vehicle damages from images for insurance claim automation, using Python, TensorFlow/Keras, and OpenCV.
Facial Emotion Recognition System: Implemented a real-time system leveraging OpenCV and TensorFlow/Keras for live emotion detection, with automated preprocessing pipelines and model inference.
COMPUTER VISION & NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING (NLP)
Fine-tuned CamemBERT for multi-class email classification ; +20 F1 points on minority classes via class rebalancing and stratified cross-validation.
Integrated ERPNext REST APIs (token auth) to auto-create quotes, invoices, and delivery notes with centralized audit logging.
Development of an archive management application
Stb Bank Tunisie
Drove modular refactors to improve maintainability and stabilize release cadence; delivered minor features and maintenance.
